title: Space email Send now goes grey on an empty audience with no reason given

source.ref: Toni House of Fates QA audit 2026-11-16 (project thread)

detail:
EVIDENCE: components/spaces/marketing/space-send-panel.tsx disabled Send now whenever the live eligible count was 0 and showed nothing beside it. For a Space whose contacts are imported and not yet confirmed as marketing subscribers, every audience counts 0, so the owner faced a dead button with no explanation.

CLOSED 2026-11-16: when the count is 0 a short line under the button says "No one in this audience can get marketing email yet. Imported contacts need to be confirmed as subscribers.", tied to the button with aria-describedby. Probe scripts/probes/space-send-disabled-reason.mjs fails on the prior tree and passes here.

NOT DONE HERE: the AudiencePicker reports 0 while a count is being checked, so the line can show for a moment during a recheck. The composer shell (components/spaces/email/composer-shell.tsx) disables Send and Schedule on the same condition and was left as is.
